available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`)

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type to be used in PCM modeling

region.description: Location where the component applies. Can be a zone or node.

capital_costs.description: Capital costs for investing in a technology. Units: USD/MW

operation_costs.description: Fixed and variable O&M costs for a technology. Units: USD/MWh

co2.description: Carbon Intensity of fuel. Units: t/MMBTU

cofire_start_limits.description: Minimum and maximum blending level of each fuel during start-up process for multi-fuel generator. Units: 1

cofire_level_limits.description: Minimum and maximum blending level of each fuel during normal generation process for multi-fuel generator. Units: 1

unit_size.description: Used for discrete investment decisions. Size of each unit being built. Units: MW

capacity_limits.description: Minimum and maximum allowable installed capacity for a technology. Units: MW

outage_factor.description: Derating factor to account for planned or forced outages of a technology. Fraction of hours in a year where technology is unavailable. Units: 1

min_generation_fraction.description: Minimum generation as a fraction of total capacity. Units: 1

ramp_limits.description: Maximum decrease and increase in output between operation periods. Fraction of nameplate capacity per minute. Units: 1

time_limits.description: Minimum amount of time a resource has to stay in the committed or shutdown state (hours). Units: h

start_fuel_mmbtu_per_mw.description: Startup fuel use per MW of nameplate capacity of each generator. Units: MMBtu/MW

lifetime.description: Maximum number of years a technology can be active once installed (years). Units: yr

requirements.description: List of requirement IDs associated with the component

financial_data.description: Struct containing relevant financial information for a technology
